tips_en: Start with Paper 1 (BDH-CQ): it delivers concrete, striking results—breaking the cost-accuracy frontier on ARC-AGI-1 (29.5% pass@2 at ~$0.0007/task)—and its core idea of doing computation in a continuous latent workspace rather than emitting tokens is intellectually crisp. Papers 1 and 3 form a natural pair: both exploit latent representations as a reusable, efficient interface that decouples downstream reasoning/generation from the underlying backbone (in-context recurrent memory in BDH-CQ, VAE latents in Latent-to-4D), making them worth reading back-to-back. Save Paper 2 for after, as its position-paper framing and broad paradigm proposal will land better once you have the more technical contributions in mind.
tips_zth: 建议优先阅读论文 1（BDH-CQ）：它在 ARC-AGI-1 上以约 $0.0007/任务的成本打破成本-精度帕累托前沿（29.5% pass@2），且“在连续潜空间中推理而非生成 token”的核心思想十分清晰。论文 1 与论文 3 是一对值得连读的工作：二者都把潜变量表示作为一种可复用、高效的接口，将下游推理/生成与底层骨干解耦（前者是上下文循环记忆，后者是 VAE 潜空间）。论文 2 是定位型/概念性文章，建议放在最后阅读，这样在已掌握两篇技术性论文后再看其宏大范式会更容易把握。
